task.description: Implement cryptographically secure pickup code generation and secure hashing for storage.
task.rationale: Pickup codes must be secure (unpredictable) and only stored as hashes for security. Plaintext returned exactly once during storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Pickup code generation with cryptographically secure random values
Secure hashing using bcrypt or Argon2 (not MD5/SHA1)
Only hash stored in database, never plaintext
Plaintext code returned exactly once during storage operation
task.implementationNotes: Created PickupCodeService using crypto.randomInt for cryptographically secure 6-digit code generation. bcrypt with cost factor 12 for secure hashing. verify() method uses bcrypt.compare() for constant-time comparison. Configurable code length and salt rounds. Plaintext returned only during generation.
task.testEvidence: Unit tests cover: code generation format (6 digits), uniqueness across multiple calls, bcrypt hash format verification, custom length/salt rounds, verification with matching/non-matching codes, security properties (no MD5/SHA1), entropy validation. Total: 12 test assertions.
